mapper.sql: v.id, v.avatar_id, v.account_id, a.status as avatar_status, v.status as version_status, v.base_file_id, v.manifest_file_id, v.preview_file_id, v.frame_width, v.frame_height, v.anchor_x, v.anchor_y, v.qa_report
mapper.select: select from p_avatar_version v join p_avatar a on a.id = v.avatar_id and a.account_id = v.account_id where v.account_id = #{accountId} and v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and v.id = #{versionId} for update

select from p_avatar_version v join p_avatar a on a.id = v.avatar_id and a.account_id = v.account_id where v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and v.id = #{versionId} and v.status = 'PUBLISHED' and (v.account_id = #{accountId} or (a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED'))
select id, status, revision from p_avatar where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{avatarId} for update
select action_code, atlas_file_id, preview_file_id, frame_count, fps, loop_enabled, frame_layout from p_avatar_action where avatar_version_id = #{avatarVersionId} order by action_code

select id, account_id, purpose, storage_provider, bucket, object_key, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, width, height, status from p_file where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{fileId} and status = 'AVAILABLE'

select count(*) from p_avatar_version v left join p_file base on base.id = v.base_file_id and base.account_id = #{accountId} and base.status = 'AVAILABLE' left join p_file manifest on manifest.id = v.manifest_file_id and manifest.account_id = #{accountId} and manifest.status = 'AVAILABLE' left join p_file preview on preview.id = v.preview_file_id and preview.account_id = #{accountId} and preview.status = 'AVAILABLE' where v.id = #{avatarVersionId} and (v.base_file_id is null or v.manifest_file_id is null or v.preview_file_id is null or base.id is null or manifest.id is null or preview.id is null)

select count(*) from p_avatar_action a left join p_file atlas on atlas.id = a.atlas_file_id and atlas.account_id = #{accountId} and atlas.status = 'AVAILABLE' left join p_file preview on preview.id = a.preview_file_id and preview.account_id = #{accountId} and preview.status = 'AVAILABLE' where a.avatar_version_id = #{avatarVersionId} and (atlas.id is null or (a.preview_file_id is not null and preview.id is null))
mapper.update: update p_avatar_version set status = 'PUBLISHED', accepted_by = #{acceptedBy}, accepted_at = utc_timestamp(3), published_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{avatarVersionId} and status = 'REVIEW'

update p_avatar set current_version_id = #{avatarVersionId}, status = 'PUBLISHED', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{avatarId} and status not in ('DELETING', 'DELETED', 'DISABLED')
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_resource_reference r join p_avatar_version v on v.id = r.resource_id where r.resource_type = 'AVATAR_VERSION' and v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and r.state in ('RESERVED', 'CONFIRMED')

select count(*) from session_db.s_session s join p_app_config c on c.id = s.app_config_id join p_avatar_version v on v.id = c.avatar_version_id where v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and s.status in ('CREATING', 'ACTIVE', 'DELETING', 'FAILED') and s.deleted_at is null
select count(*) from p_generation_task where account_id = #{accountId} and avatar_id = #{avatarId} and status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING')
mapper.update: update p_avatar set status = 'DELETING', cleanup_status = 'PENDING', next_cleanup_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3), revision = revision + 1 where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{avatarId} and revision = #{revision} and status not in ('DELETING', 'DELETED')
mapper.insert: insert into p_avatar_review (id, created_at, account_id, avatar_id, avatar_version_id, visual_accepted, review_note) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{avatarId}, #{versionId}, 1, #{reviewNote})
mapper.select: select cast(a.id as char) avatarId, cast(a.current_version_id as char) versionId, a.name, a.visibility, a.status, f.object_key previewObjectKey from p_avatar a join p_avatar_version v on v.id = a.current_version_id and v.avatar_id = a.id left join p_file f on f.id = v.preview_file_id and f.account_id = v.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' where a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and v.status = 'PUBLISHED' order by a.updated_at desc, a.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from p_avatar a join p_avatar_version v on v.id = a.current_version_id where a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and v.status = 'PUBLISHED'

select cast(a.id as char) avatarId, cast(a.current_version_id as char) currentVersionId, a.name, a.visibility, a.status, cast(a.revision as char) revision, f.object_key previewObjectKey, (select count(*) from p_avatar_version v where v.avatar_id=a.id and v.status not in ('DELETING','DELETED')) versionCount from p_avatar a left join p_avatar_version v on v.id=a.current_version_id and v.avatar_id=a.id left join p_file f on f.id=v.preview_file_id and f.status='AVAILABLE' where a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.visibility='PRIVATE' and a.status<>'DELETED' and (#{status} is null or a.status=#{status}) and (#{keyword} is null or a.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by a.updated_at desc,a.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}

select count(*) from p_avatar a where a.account_id=#{accountId} and a.visibility='PRIVATE' and a.status<>'DELETED' and (#{status} is null or a.status=#{status}) and (#{keyword} is null or a.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))

select distinct cast(a.id as char) applicationId,a.name,a.status from p_resource_reference r join p_avatar_version v on v.id=r.resource_id join p_application a on a.id=r.holder_id and a.account_id=r.account_id where r.account_id=#{accountId} and r.resource_type='AVATAR_VERSION' and v.avatar_id=#{avatarId} and r.holder_type='APP_CURRENT' and r.state in ('RESERVED','CONFIRMED') order by a.name,a.id
select request_hash requestHash,resource_id resourceId from p_api_idempotency where account_id=#{accountId} and scope=#{scope} and request_id=#{requestId} for update

select cast(a.id as char) avatarId, cast(a.current_version_id as char) versionId, a.name, a.visibility, a.status, cast(a.account_id as char) creatorAccountId, a.revision, (select count(*) from p_generation_task t where t.avatar_id = a.id) taskCount, (select count(*) from p_avatar_version av where av.avatar_id = a.id) versionCount, f.object_key previewObjectKey from p_avatar a left join p_avatar_version v on v.id = a.current_version_id and v.avatar_id = a.id left join p_file f on f.id = v.preview_file_id and f.account_id = v.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' where a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status not in ('DELETED') and (#{status} is null or a.status = #{status}) order by a.updated_at desc, a.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from p_avatar a where a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status not in ('DELETED') and (#{status} is null or a.status = #{status})

select cast(a.id as char) avatarId, a.name, a.visibility, a.status, cast(a.current_version_id as char) currentVersionId, a.revision, case when a.account_id = #{accountId} then 1 else 0 end owned from p_avatar a where a.id = #{avatarId} and (a.account_id = #{accountId} or (a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED'))

select cast(v.id as char) versionId, v.version_no versionNo, v.status, v.created_at createdAt, case when a.account_id = #{accountId} then 1 else 0 end owned from p_avatar_version v join p_avatar a on a.id = v.avatar_id and a.account_id = v.account_id where v.avatar_id = #{avatarId} and v.status not in ('DELETING','DELETED') and (a.account_id = #{accountId} or (a.visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and a.status = 'PUBLISHED' and v.status = 'PUBLISHED' and a.current_version_id = v.id)) order by v.version_no desc
select cast(id as char) avatarId, status, revision from p_avatar where id = #{avatarId} and visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and status not in ('DELETING','DELETED') for update
mapper.update: update p_avatar set status = #{newStatus}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{avatarId} and visibility = 'OFFICIAL' and status = #{expectedStatus}
